Key Responsibilities
1. Brand Visual Design
Lead visual design projects for HEYTEA's North America market, including new product launches, packaging, collaborations, campaigns, key visuals, in-store materials, and other brand touch points.
Participate in the full creative process, from early concepts and creative direction to design development and final execution.
Develop a strong understanding of HEYTEA's brand identity and visual language, while bringing insights from North American culture, lifestyles, and aesthetics into the work.
Think beyond individual design pieces and explore how creative concepts can be effectively extended across different formats, materials, channels, and consumer touch points.
2. Creative & Design
Bring strong visual taste and creative thinking, with the ability to independently develop and execute design concepts.
Stay curious about areas beyond design, including art, culture, fashion, lifestyle, and the world around you.
Have your own perspective on branding and design. Go beyond simply executing briefs and actively contribute to discussions around why we are doing something, how we should approach it, and what other possibilities exist .
Stay sensitive to emerging design trends and visual expressions, while maintaining your own judgment rather than simply following trends.
3. Project Ownership & Execution
Independently own projects from brief and creative exploration through design development and final execution.
Take initiative and drive projects forward once the direction is established, without relying on detailed instructions at every step.
Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams including Marketing, Product, Operations, Supply Chain, and external creative partners to bring ideas to life.
Manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize time and resources effectively.
Qualifications
Education
Bachelor’s degree or above in Visual Communication, Graphic Design, Brand Design, or a related field is preferred.
Experience
3–5+ years of experience in brand, visual, or graphic design , preferably within consumer brands, F&B, retail, lifestyle, or other consumer-facing industries.
Experience participating in or building a brand’s visual identity from 0 to 1 is highly preferred.
Proven experience independently owning and delivering complete design projects from concept to execution.
Currently based in New York .
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.
Fluent in both Chinese and English , with the ability to use both as working languages.
What We’re Looking For
Strong visual fundamentals and a thoughtful understanding of typography, layout, graphics, and brand design.
A strong sense of aesthetics and sensitivity to quality and visual details.
Curious about culture, art, fashion, lifestyle, and the world around you.
Someone with your own ideas and perspectives, who is also open to discussion, experimentation, iteration, and challenging existing ideas.
A self-driven designer who can balance creative thinking with strong execution and project ownership.

About Us
We are a fast-growing tea beverage brand with an expanding retail and franchise presence across the U.S. Our mission is to bring high-quality, innovative, and culturally inspired tea experiences to our customers. As we continue to grow, we are looking for a Business Development Coordinator to keep our site selection, leasing, and franchise expansion projects on track.

Position Overview
This is an execution- and coordination-focused role, not a sales or deal-origination position. The Business Development Coordinator is the person who makes sure our expansion pipeline actually moves: tracking every open item, chasing pending responses, keeping project records and documents accurate and current, and maintaining clear, professional communication with brokers, landlords, property managers, and internal teams.
You will not be asked to prospect, pitch, or negotiate deals. Instead, you will own the follow-up: knowing at any moment what each project is waiting on, who owes what, and what happens next. The ideal candidate is highly responsive, methodical, and detail-driven, with strong written communication and the judgment to know what needs internal confirmation before anything is committed externally.

Key Responsibilities
Project follow-up and pending item tracking
Track the status, open items, and deadlines of every active site selection, leasing, and franchise expansion project; maintain a clear picture of what each project is waiting on and who is responsible.
Proactively follow up on pending responses, missing documents, and unresolved next steps — without needing reminders — and escalate items at risk of stalling.
Manage multiple concurrent projects and contact threads, advancing them by priority rather than working task by task.
Run and maintain the BD pipeline tracker, project status reports, and to-do lists; keep updates timely and accurate so leadership always has a current view.
Stakeholder communication
Serve as a reliable day-to-day contact for brokers, landlords, property managers, and franchise-related parties; respond promptly and keep all threads moving.
Draft clear, professional English emails and routine business correspondence; confirm details, request missing information, and document agreed next steps.
Coordinate with internal teams (legal, operations, training, marketing, finance) to obtain reviews, approvals, and deliverables needed to keep projects on schedule.
Prepare meeting notes and action-item summaries; circulate follow-ups and verify that agreed actions are completed.
Document and information accuracy
Maintain organized, complete, and version-controlled project files, including LOIs, lease-related materials, franchise documents, and correspondence records.
Review incoming and outgoing materials for completeness — spot missing attachments, outdated versions, unanswered questions, and undefined next steps before they cause delays.
Exercise sound judgment on what information requires internal confirmation before being shared externally; never commit to terms, timelines, or conditions outside of approved scope.
General support
Provide flexible support in line with BD team rhythms, including occasional after-hours meetings, urgent follow-ups, or weekend support as needed.
Complete ad-hoc tasks and assignments delegated by the leadership team in a timely and high-quality manner.

Qualifications
Bachelor's degree required.
2–3 years of experience in coordination- or support-oriented roles such as sales coordination, business development support, client service, account coordination, project coordination, leasing/real estate support, or commercial property/mall support. Real estate or site-selection experience is a plus but not required.
Demonstrated follow-through: a track record of closing loops, chasing pending items to resolution, and keeping projects moving without supervision or reminders.
Proven ability to track and advance multiple projects and multiple points of contact simultaneously, with clear prioritization.
Excellent written English; able to communicate clearly and professionally with brokers, landlords, and property managers.
High attention to detail and strong sensitivity to information completeness, document versions, and record accuracy.
Structured and process-minded; comfortable building and maintaining trackers, pipelines, checklists, and meeting documentation.
Service-oriented with sound business judgment; understands what needs verification and what should not be promised.
Comfortable with the pace of a business development function, including occasional after-hours or weekend availability.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint); experience with project trackers or CRM tools is a plus.

What We Offer
Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.
Health, dental, and vision insurance.
Employee discount on our tea products.
A collaborative and entrepreneurial team environment.
Remote work
Exposure to the full retail expansion process — site selection, leasing, and franchise development — with clear room to grow within the BD function.

Position Summary
The Area Operations Support Supervisor plays a critical role in supporting regional store operations by driving execution of corporate initiatives, analyzing operational performance, and improving efficiency across stores. This role partners closely with regional operations leadership and cross-functional teams to ensure operational excellence, data-driven decision-making, and consistent execution of company standards.

Key Responsibilities
Operational Initiatives Execution & Performance Diagnostics
Track and monitor the execution of regional operational initiatives and corporate programs on a quarterly basis
Collect, consolidate, and analyze operational data to ensure effective implementation of company strategies at the regional level
Identify operational gaps, risks, and improvement opportunities through data analysis and store feedback
Develop actionable solutions tailored to local market conditions and drive execution with cross-functional stakeholders
New Product Launch & Campaign Management
Coordinate pre-launch readiness for new products, including materials preparation, training support, and system setup
Monitor post-launch performance and conduct data-driven reviews to optimize future product and promotional strategies
Inventory & Materials Management
Support regional inventory tracking and reporting processes
Maintain and monitor locally sourced materials and supplier-related information
Provide insights and recommendations to improve supply chain efficiency and operational effectiveness
Labor & Workforce Efficiency Analysis
Assist in monitoring labor hours and workforce utilization across the region
Analyze labor efficiency metrics (e.g., labor cost, productivity) and provide actionable insights to operations leadership
Support initiatives aimed at optimizing labor allocation while maintaining operational standards
Financial & Margin Analysis (P&L Support)
Prepare and deliver weekly and monthly gross margin reports for the region
Monitor financial performance, identify variances, and partner with operations to implement corrective actions
Maintain and enhance margin calculation tools to support franchise/partner store financial management capabilities
Meeting Coordination & Execution Follow-Up
Organize and facilitate regional operations meetings
Prepare data and materials in advance and document clear meeting minutes
Track follow-up actions to ensure accountability and completion of key initiatives
Systems & Operational Infrastructure Management
Manage system access and permissions based on business needs to ensure data accuracy and security
Coordinate updates to operating hours across digital platforms (e.g., app, online ordering systems)
Support store setup needs, including email account creation and maintenance of operational tracking tools
Partner Relations & Compliance Support
Assist in managing partner/franchise compliance with company policies and operational standards
Support documentation and communication related to policy violations, including issuance of formal notices
Prepare and distribute periodic compliance summaries to maintain operational discipline and transparency
Cross-Functional Store Experience Program
Organize and coordinate store immersion programs for corporate and support functions
Enhance cross-functional understanding of store operations and improve collaboration between teams

Qualifications
Education & Experience:
Bachelor’s degree or above; minimum of 3 years of experience in F&B operations, retail operations support, store management, or supply chain-related roles
Bilingual Communication:
Fluency in both English and Mandarin Chinese required, with strong written and verbal communication skills to collaborate with global headquarters and local teams
Data & Analytical Skills:
Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets; ability to independently analyze data and generate actionable reports (weekly/monthly)
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify trends and recommend solutions
Project Management:
Proven experience leading or supporting regional or cross-functional projects
Highly organized with strong attention to detail and execution discipline
Mobility:
Valid U.S. driver’s license preferred; ability to travel within the region for store visits and meetings as needed
Work Environment & Expectations
Fast-paced, multi-unit retail/food service environment
Requires strong cross-functional collaboration and adaptability
Role may require periodic travel within different states

About the Role
HEYTEA is seeking a detail-oriented Warehouse Operations Specialist (3PL) to support our U.S. supply chain operations at our third-party warehouse in Edison, New Jersey .This role oversees the day-to-day execution of warehouse services provided by our third-party logistics (3PL) partner, verifies inbound and outbound accuracy, reconciles inventory records, and coordinates carrier appointments and store shipment pickups.
You will work closely with our 3PL partner, transportation providers, and internal supply chain teams to maintain accurate inventory, resolve operational issues, and ensure reliable material supply to HEYTEA stores.

Key Responsibilities
Inbound Operations
Monitor receiving activities performed by the 3PL partner, including unloading, counting, and put-away.
Verify received quantities, SKUs, lot numbers, expiration dates, and receiving records against supporting documentation.
Investigate receiving discrepancies and follow up with relevant parties to ensure timely resolution.
Outbound Operations
Monitor order fulfillment activities, including picking, verification, packing, and loading, against store orders.
Conduct spot checks of SKUs, quantities, and store destination information to verify shipment accuracy.
Coordinate the resolution of incorrect items, missing items, short shipments, and other fulfillment discrepancies.
Inventory Control
Monitor the 3PL partner’s cycle counts and scheduled physical inventories.
Perform targeted inventory spot checks, investigate variances, and track corrective actions.
Verify lot and expiration-date records and monitor adherence to applicable inventory rotation procedures.
Inventory Data and Reconciliation
Review daily receiving and shipping transactions and reconcile WMS records with warehouse documentation and physical count results.
Identify and follow up on missing transactions, duplicate entries, quantity discrepancies, and other data issues.
Maintain timely, complete, and accurate operational records.
Carrier Scheduling and Coordination
Coordinate carrier appointments, pickup schedules, and loading handoffs with transportation providers and the 3PL partner.
Monitor shipment readiness against store delivery plans.
Address appointment delays, missed pickups, and loading exceptions, and escalate risks that may affect store supply.
Operational Issue Resolution
Monitor the 3PL partner’s adherence to established warehouse procedures and applicable product-handling, storage, and safety requirements.
Document and follow up on product damage, inventory variances, receiving and shipping errors, and transportation exceptions.
Coordinate corrective actions with responsible parties and verify completion.
Reporting and Cross-Functional Support
Prepare reports on inbound and outbound activity, inventory count results, shipment accuracy, and operational exceptions.
Share operational updates, recurring issues, and improvement recommendations with the U.S. supply chain team.
Support new-store material requirements, inventory reviews, and other related warehouse operations activities in collaboration with U.S. and headquarters teams.

Required Qualifications
At least two years of experience in warehousing, logistics, inventory control, or a related operational role.
Working knowledge of receiving, shipping, inventory counting, lot tracking, and inventory reconciliation processes.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience using a warehouse management system (WMS).
Ability to review operational data, identify discrepancies, investigate issues, and follow through on corrective actions.
Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and accountability for data accuracy.
Effective communication and coordination skills, with the ability to collaborate with warehouse partners, carriers, and internal teams.
Professional working proficiency in English and Mandarin Chinese sufficient to communicate with U.S. warehouse and transportation partners and Mandarin-speaking headquarters colleagues.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience working on-site with, or overseeing service delivery by, a U.S. 3PL warehouse.
Experience in food and beverage supply chains, temperature-controlled warehousing, or cold chain operations.
